Project
Recap Helpix ai (A multi disease detection
system)
project name
Helpix is an AI-based health screening system that helps detect
diseases at an early stage using a smartphone.
It is designed to address major healthcare challenges in India, such
as late disease detection, shortage of doctors in rural areas, high
diagnostic costs, use of multiple health apps, and concerns about
data privacy.
Helpix provides fast, affordable, secure, and offline health screening,
making it especially useful for people living in remote and low-resource
regions.

Proposed solution
•HELPIX trains an AI model to detect diseases through cough and voice analysis
using MFCC and spectrogram-based deep learning.
•HELPIX trains a skin-image–based AI model using CNN architectures to identify
multiple dermatological diseases.
•HELPIX develops a symptom-based prediction model that analyzes user-
reported symptoms to estimate disease risk.
•HELPIX converts rural mode into TFLite/ONNX to enable complete offline
processing on mobile devices.
•HELPIX ensures privacy and accessibility by performing all AI computations
locally without cloud dependency.
•HELPIX combines audio, image, and symptom outputs using a multimodal
fusion approach for higher accuracy.
